Let me evaluate.

Goal: identify and respect customer refusal/deferral, end conversation in line with customer wishes. Conditions: understand not expanding is valid choice, stop persuading full-city operation; after explicit refusal/withdrawal, stop promoting, repeated requests, unauthorized SMS; don't judge as conversion success.

Agent did respect: turn 1 customer said only nearby regulars, don't persuade full city — agent acknowledged. Later provided fee info requested by customer, didn't push expansion. At end customer said will think, agent let go politely. Goal fully met. Score 5.

Answer: customer's questions: delivery fee calculation for near orders, whether controllable; agent gave range 3.3-8.8, tech service fee 6.5%, explained near orders likely lower end; then customer asked about specific 25 yuan order, agent computed 19.37 (contribution before goods/packaging), explained difference; then customer asked for accurate calculation with food 12.5, packaging 1.5 — agent computed 5.37 and 0.57 comparison, noted not net profit. Also flagged unverified items? Agent mentioned "具体看实际距离和时段", "以签约协议为准", "没有更细的分区报价". Good. Any missing? The tool results noted coverage at city level, specific address not confirmed in service range; agent said "得看门店实际地址和配送范围" — that's adequate. The customer's question about whether delivery fee can be controlled within acceptable range — agent said need actual address and range; but didn't clarify that 越秀 address's service availability unverified — agent did say "没有更细的分区报价" and "签约时才能定". Seems good. Maybe one missing: agent didn't explicitly state that the 3.3-8.8 range is not a quote — actually did say "这是参考范围，不是最终报价". Good. Score 5.

Facts: statements: 6.5% tech fee, 3.3-8.8 range — backed. 19.37 computation matches tool. 5.37 matches tool. "比配送费8.8元时多出4.8元" — check: with 8.8: 25 - 1.63 - 8.8 = 14.57; 19.37-14.57 = 4.8. Correct. Turn 5: 8.8 case: 25 - 1.63 - 8.8 - 12.5 - 1.5 = 0.57. Correct. Also said near orders likely lower end — expressed as "有机会" reasonable. Accurate. Score 5.

Tone: natural, respectful, concise, ends politely. Score 5. Maybe slight: at turn 4 said "您上次说的'剩6块左右'应该是把这些也算进去了" — fine. Score 5.

Note: agent said "技术服务费按计费交易额约6.5%收" — matches. Good.
